standards.name: Tesla

findings.title: Follow-up exceptions overwrite the initial launcher traceback
findings.standard: Workspace AGENTS.md Verification requires relevant logs/errors; stepmind-gpu-worker/SKILL.md requires distinguishing query and terminal workload failures.
findings.evidence: The initial spawn_tasks exception and the later API/check exception both write launcher.failure.log; the final error field also retains only the later failure.

standards.scope: Independent read-only review; no client, platform or workload call.

spec.name: Poincare

findings.title: Pre-start worker failure loses terminal job evidence
findings.spec: execution_plan_2026-10-25.md:102 requires exact creator/quota/resources/image/source and replica/container terminal evidence.
findings.evidence: spawn_tasks waits internally; its exception prevents the return-based job identity, and the only fallback depends on worker_started.json.

findings.title: Follow-up exceptions overwrite the initial launcher traceback
findings.spec: execution_plan_2026-10-25.md:104 requires every raw workload, validation, memory or platform failure to remain explicit evidence.
findings.evidence: The later exception replaces launcher.failure.log and the receipt error field.

spec.scope: Independent read-only review; no client, platform or workload call.

remediation.identity: Synchronously capture the hash-bound original SDK Job Create event before its unchanged blocking wait; eliminate dependence on worker startup.
remediation.errors: Retain initial launch_error and launcher.failure.log, plus later error and launcher.followup.failure.log.
